Product Title:
SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch

Short Marketing Description:
Elevate your fitness journey with the SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch, offering seamless Bluetooth calling, comprehensive health monitoring, and a stunning 1.9-inch AMOLED display, all packed into a sleek, waterproof design.

Key Features:
- Vibrant 1.9-inch AMOLED display
- Bluetooth calling for hands-free convenience
- 7-day battery life for uninterrupted performance
- Continuous heart-rate monitoring
- Advanced sleep tracking
- IP68 waterproof rating for durability
- Comprehensive fitness activity tracking

Promotional Tagline:
Stay connected. Stay fit. Stay ahead.
